blocks.text: 1. Verbos para contar lo que alguien dijo

head: Patrón
Ejemplo
Verbos
rows: advise, encourage, warn, persuade, remind, urge
accuse of, blame for, apologise for, insist on
She explained that she was ill.
explain, claim, admit, point out, insist

blocks.title: Verbos precisos en lugar de say
blocks.text: En lugar de repetir siempre he said, en el nivel C2 se usa el verbo que expresa la intención: "I'll do it" → He promised to do it; "You stole it!" → She accused him of stealing it; "Don't touch it" → He warned me not to touch it. Y nunca que + subjuntivo: me animó a que lo solicitara = she urged me to apply.

head: Correcto
Incorrecto
rows: She suggested going to the cinema.
She suggested to go to the cinema.
I recommend you to book early. (mejor evitarlo)

blocks.title: suggest nunca con complemento + to
blocks.text: suggest nunca tiene el patrón suggest someone to do. Usa suggest doing o suggest that someone (should) do. Sugirió que fuéramos = She suggested going o She suggested that we (should) go, nunca She suggested us to go. Y insistir en pagar = insist on paying, no insist in.

head: Inglés
Significado
rows: I saw him cross the road.
I saw him crossing the road.
He was seen to leave. (pasiva: con to)

blocks.title: Verbo + complemento + preposición
items: recordar a alguien a (algo o alguien)
dar las gracias a alguien por

rows: He denied to take the money.
He insisted to pay the bill.
He insisted on paying the bill.
The rain prevented us to go out.
The rain prevented us from going out.
She congratulated me for my exam.
She congratulated me on my exam.
He was seen leave the building.
He was seen to leave the building.

blocks.text: Completa con la palabra o la forma correcta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.full: She persuaded me to take the job.
He insisted on carrying my bags.

items.q: The fog prevented the plane ______ landing.
items.full: The fog prevented the plane from landing.

items.q: She warned us not ______ swim there.
items.full: She warned us not to swim there.
We congratulated them on their wedding.

items.q: I heard someone ______ my name, but nobody was there.
items.full: I heard someone call my name, but nobody was there.

items.q: The suspect was seen ______ the bank.
items.full: The suspect was seen to enter the bank.

items.q: Él propuso ir a dar un paseo.
items.a: He suggested going for a walk.

items.q: La lluvia nos impidió jugar fuera.
items.a: The rain prevented us from playing outside.

items.q: Ella me convenció para que me quedara.
